s: Chapter VI: restraint, confinement, criminal force and assault
अध्याय 6: अवरोध, परिरोध, आपराधिक बल और हमला
en:
Eleven sections on one page

126Wrongful restraint
127Wrongful confinement, and seven aggravated forms
128–129Force · criminal force
130Assault
131–136Punishments: general, public servant, dishonour, theft, confinement, provocation
Section 126

Wrongful restraint

1Voluntarily obstructs a person
2So that he cannot go in a direction he has a right to proceed
3Simple imprisonment up to 1 month, or ₹5,000, or both
  • Exception: obstructing a private way one believes in good faith he may lawfully obstruct · old ss.339, 341
Section 127

Wrongful confinement

Sub-s.CaseTerm
(2)Wrongful confinement1 year, or ₹5,000
(3)For 3 days or more3 years, or ₹10,000
(4)For 10 days or more5 years + fine ≥ ₹10,000
(5)After a writ for liberation is issued+ 2 years
(6)In secret+ 3 years
(7)To extort property or constrain to an illegal act3 years + fine
(8)To extort a confession or compel restoration of property3 years + fine
  • Definition, sub-s.(1): restraint that keeps a person within certain circumscribing limits · old ss.340, 342 to 348
Section 128

Force

Whatcausing motion, change of motion or cessation of motion
(a)by his own bodily power
(b)by disposing a substance so it acts without further act
(c)by inducing an animal
  • Old s.349
Section 129

Criminal force

Force becomes criminal when

✓Used intentionally
✓Without that person's consent
✓To commit an offence, or to cause injury, fear or annoyance
  • Pulling up a woman's veil, or setting a dog on Z, without consent · old s.350
Section 130

Assault

1A gesture or preparation
2Intending or knowing it will make a person present apprehend criminal force
3Assault, though no force is actually used · old s.351
  • Mere words are not assault, but words can give a gesture that meaning (Explanation)

He picked up a stick and said, “I will give you a beating.” The words alone are nothing. With the stick, it is assault.

Section 131

Assault or criminal force otherwise than on grave provocation

3 monthsor ₹1,000, or both
No mitigationif provocation was sought, or came from a lawful act, a public servant or private defence
Old s.352
Section 132

To deter a public servant from his duty

2 yearsor fine, or both
Whenin execution of duty, to deter him, or in consequence of his lawful act
Old s.353
Section 133

With intent to dishonour

2 yearsor fine, or both
Old s.355
Section 134

In attempt to commit theft of property carried

2 yearsor fine, or both
Propertythat the person is wearing or carrying
Old s.356
Section 135

In attempt wrongfully to confine

1 yearor ₹5,000, or both
Old s.357
Section 136

Assault or criminal force on grave provocation

1 monthsimple, or ₹1,000, or both
Old s.358same Explanation as s.131
Wrongful restraint · s.126Wrongful confinement · s.127
Blocked in one directionBlocked in every direction
Free to go elsewhereKept within limits
GenusSpecies

Do not mix these up

Assault needs no touch; criminal force does.

Confinement: 3 days → 3 years, 10 days → 5 years.

Sub-ss.(5) and (6) of s.127 add to the other punishment; they do not replace it.

Wrongful restraint carries simple imprisonment only.

हमला

1कोई अंगविक्षेप या तैयारी

  • केवल शब्द हमला नहीं, पर शब्द अंगविक्षेप को वह अर्थ दे सकते हैं (स्पष्टीकरण)

उसने डंडा उठाया और कहा, “मैं तुम्हें पीटूँगा।” केवल शब्द कुछ नहीं। डंडे के साथ, यह हमला है।
